title: Multiparameter Quantum Metrology in Molecular Dimers
summary: We investigate multiparameter quantum estimation in a molecular dimer composed of two dipole--dipole interacting two-level systems, focusing on the simultaneous estimation of temperature $T$ and detuning $Λ$. By employing a vectorization approach to derive the quantum Fisher information matrix, we analyze the precision limits of both simultaneous and individual estimation strategies.
